name: EOSR WC-MVP-0001 Closure Bootstrap

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - eosr/close-wc-mvp-0001-bootstrap

permissions:
  contents: write

env:
  EOS_ACTOR: chatgpt

jobs:
  close:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 35
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Enter exact accepted Work Cycle review baseline
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          BASE_SHA="da624372d2d4b7776c521ec789b06dc584c4b3d6"
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
          git fetch origin main
          test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$BASE_SHA"
          git reset --hard "$BASE_SHA"
          test ! -e .github/workflows/eosr-close-wc-mvp-0001-bootstrap.yml
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"

      - name: Prove WC_CLOSE gate and close cycle
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          ./scripts/eos verify --strict
          ./scripts/eos state status
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check
          ./scripts/eos gate explain WC_CLOSE WC-MVP-0001
          ./scripts/eos close-cycle WC-MVP-0001 \
            --by 'Thomas Carter' \
            --reason 'Human-authorized governed closure after all planned Work Packets closed and the accepted Work Cycle review merged through PR #208.'
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import csv, json
          state=json.loads(Path('.eos/state/current.json').read_text())
          assert state['entities']['WC']['WC-MVP-0001']['lifecycle_state']=='CLOSED'
          assert state['entities']['PI']['PI-MVP-001']['lifecycle_state']=='ACTIVE'
          for wp in ('WP-MVP-0001','WP-MVP-0002','WP-MVP-0003'):
              assert state['entities']['WP'][wp]['lifecycle_state']=='CLOSED'
          rows={r['id']:r for r in csv.DictReader(open('.eos/work-cycles.tsv'), delimiter='\t')}
          assert rows['WC-MVP-0001']['status']=='CLOSED'
          wc=Path('engineering/work-cycles/WC-MVP-0001.md').read_text()
          assert '**Status:** CLOSED' in wc
          review=Path('engineering/reviews/WC-MVP-0001-REVIEW.md').read_text()
          assert '**Decision:** ACCEPTED' in review
          assert '**ACHIEVED.**' in review
          PY

      - name: Refresh closed packet evidence and synchronize projections
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          ./scripts/eos validate WP-MVP-0001 --profile wp
          ./scripts/eos validate WP-MVP-0002 --profile wp --execution EXEC-0004
          ./scripts/eos validate WP-MVP-0003 --profile wp --execution EXEC-0005
          ./scripts/eos verify --strict
          ./scripts/eos state status
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import csv, json
          state=json.loads(Path('.eos/state/current.json').read_text())
          assert state['entities']['WC']['WC-MVP-0001']['lifecycle_state']=='CLOSED'
          assert state['entities']['PI']['PI-MVP-001']['lifecycle_state']=='ACTIVE'
          rows=list(csv.DictReader(open('.eos/evidence.tsv'), delimiter='\t'))
          for wp, execution in [('WP-MVP-0002','EXEC-0004'),('WP-MVP-0003','EXEC-0005')]:
              current=[r for r in rows if r['target']==wp and r['status']!='SUPERSEDED']
              assert len(current)==3, (wp,current)
              assert all(r['status']=='VALIDATED' and r['execution']==execution for r in current), current
              assert next(r for r in current if r['validator']=='eos-integrity')['result']=='PASSED'
              assert next(r for r in current if r['validator']=='execution-acceptance')['result']=='PASSED'
          PY

      - name: Commit closure, prove stability, and publish
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          FINAL_BRANCH="eosr/close-wc-mvp-0001"
          git config user.name 'ChatGPT'
          git config user.email '41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
          git add -A
          if git diff --cached --name-only | grep -E '^(Cargo|crates/|src/|.*\.rs$|tools/eos/|product/|architecture/|specifications/|engineering/increments/|engineering/maintenance/|\.github/workflows/)'; then
            echo 'Unexpected product/governing change in Work Cycle closure.' >&2; exit 1
          fi
          git commit -m 'chore(eosr): close WC-MVP-0001'
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD^)" = "da624372d2d4b7776c521ec789b06dc584c4b3d6"
          ./scripts/eos verify --strict
          ./scripts/eos state status
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check
          cargo fmt --all -- --check
          cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
          cargo test --workspace --all-targets --all-features
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import json
          state=json.loads(Path('.eos/state/current.json').read_text())
          assert state['entities']['WC']['WC-MVP-0001']['lifecycle_state']=='CLOSED'
          assert state['entities']['PI']['PI-MVP-001']['lifecycle_state']=='ACTIVE'
          PY
          if git ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin "$FINAL_BRANCH" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'Final Work Cycle closure branch exists' >&2; exit 1; fi
          git push origin "HEAD:refs/heads/$FINAL_BRANCH"
